key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:6:105A

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:6:10E8

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:6:115C

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:6:11D0

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:6:120C
name: step_stride_and_reload_row

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:6:1224
name: retry_until_nonzero_status
description: Loops over a counter, calling sub-routines that return status values, and returns the first nonzero status. It increments a stored position each pass and returns zero if that position reaches its limit.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:6:124A

description: Decrements a 16-bit count, calls a sub-routine for each step, and advances a pointer while checking a limit.

name: decrement_counter_until_zero
description: Calls a sub-routine to load a counter, decrements it, and when it reaches zero advances a pointer and reloads. It returns zero when the pointer reaches the limit.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:6:129C
name: decrement_counter_with_reload
description: Decrements a counter and reloads it from a sub-routine each time it reaches zero. It returns the status of a failing call or zero at the limit.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:6:12E8
name: decrement_counter_check_status
description: Decrements a counter inside a loop that calls a sub-routine and checks its status before continuing. It returns the status on failure.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:6:1310
name: scan_cells_with_pointer_step
description: Scans cells in nested loops, stepping a pointer and a stored count, and returns the status when a call fails.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:6:1346
name: decrement_pointer_until_status
description: Decrements a stored count, reloading it through a sub-routine when it reaches zero. It returns zero at the limit or the status of a failing call.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:6:1364
name: clear_counters_and_scan_rows

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:6:1392
name: scan_rows_with_status_exit

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:6:13BC
name: decrement_row_count_and_reload
description: Decrements a count held in a pointer, reloads it through a sub-routine when it hits zero, and returns the status of a failing call.

name: decrement_row_count_with_status
description: Calls a sub-routine that returns a status and loops while the count stays above zero, returning the status when it is nonzero.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:6:143C

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:8:0042

description: Reads a name pointer from a global table, calls a library routine to set up the entry, and copies the name into the global name buffer. It returns zero on success and minus one on failure.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:8:0054
name: return_negative_one_stub

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:8:0058
name: load_named_entry_on_mismatch
description: Compares a name with the stored name and, when they differ, locks the entry and loads it through library calls before returning zero.

name: scan_name_and_load_entry
description: Scans an input name against a stored name and, on a match, calls library routines to load the entry. It returns zero on success and minus one on failure.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:8:0068
name: compare_name_then_load_entry
description: Compares characters of two names one by one and, when the comparison ends, loads the matching entry through library calls. It returns zero on success and minus one on failure.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:8:014E
name: restore_directory_and_fail
description: Calls two library routines to release the directory lock and restore the previous current directory, then returns minus one.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:8:0168
name: unload_driver_segment_if_loaded

name: compare_characters_ignoring_case
description: Compares two characters after folding lowercase letters to uppercase, and returns whether they match.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:devs/printer.device:8:01C4
name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero and does nothing else.

name: return_zero_handler

name: allocate_port_with_retry
description: Fills a value array and calls library functions to allocate a port buffer, repeating the allocation until it succeeds or the count runs out.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:libs/arp.library:0:026A
name: finish_port_buffer_setup
description: Calls library routines to finish setting up a port buffer, stores the buffer address into the structure, and sets a flag byte before returning.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:libs/arp.library:0:02BE
name: wait_then_increment_counter
description: Calls a library routine that waits for a signal in a loop, then increments a stored counter field once the wait completes.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:libs/arp.library:0:02D0
name: clear_field_and_release
description: Clears a field in a structure and calls a library routine to release the resource it refers to.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:libs/arp.library:0:041A
name: allocate_memory_with_header
description: Allocates a block of the requested size through the library, stores the size in a header word, and returns the block address.

name: dispatch_setup_callbacks
description: Calls several function pointers stored in a structure passed in a register and saves a routine address into a global. It runs as a setup step and returns nothing.

name: patch_jump_table_entries
description: Writes an address offset into two slots of an indirect jump table and then calls through that table.

name: call_through_table_pointer
description: Calls a routine through a pointer stored in a global table.

name: mask_global_status_bits
description: Clears selected bits of a global status word and returns the masked value.

name: return_stack_argument_value
description: Returns the value passed on the stack. The metadata marks an interrupt request register access, but the body only returns that value.

name: store_stack_word_to_global
description: Stores the word passed on the stack into a global variable.

name: return_zero_constant
description: Returns zero without performing any operations or modifying data.

name: set_struct_flag_bit
description: Sets bit one in a flag byte at a fixed offset of the structure pointed to by the address register.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns without doing anything; the body is a single return.

name: copy_entry_list_into_block
description: Allocates a block sized from the source entry count and copies the entry pairs into it. It returns the new block, or a failure value when the allocation fails.

name: find_node_by_name_string
description: Walks a singly linked list and compares each node's stored string with the input string. It returns the matching node, or zero when no node matches.

name: store_value_to_global
description: Stores the value in the first input register into a global variable.

name: store_global_and_jump_table
description: Stores the input register into a global, then transfers control through an indirect jump table entry.

name: copy_byte_to_offset_slot
description: Copies a byte from a fixed offset of the source structure into a fixed slot addressed from the base register.

name: compare_global_to_constant
description: Compares a global word with a fixed constant and returns four when they are equal, otherwise one.

name: initialize_sentinel_pointer_chain
description: Writes sentinel values into a pointed-to entry and stores the address of the next entry into several fields of two structures. It also clears a word field in one of them.

name: copy_nested_pointer_fields
description: Copies a 32-bit value found behind each of two pointer fields in the source structure into matching fields of the destination, but only when each pointer is nonnull.

name: check_flags_and_run_callbacks
description: XORs a global state word with a node flag field and checks two bits. When they match, it walks a linked list and invokes a callback for nodes with matching flags, returning zero, or the masked flag otherwise.

name: copy_word_if_both_present
description: Copies a 16-bit field from the first structure into a fixed offset of the second, but only when both pointers are nonnull.

name: combine_flag_with_callback_result
description: Calls a function through a global table and merges its result with two register bytes and a stored flag byte. It saves the merged byte and returns it combined with a byte from another structure.

name: convert_nonzero_to_minus_one
description: Returns minus one when the input register is nonzero and zero otherwise.

name: set_video_position_flag_bit
description: Sets one flag bit in a byte at a fixed offset from the base pointer. The metadata marks it as touching the vertical position register area.

name: combine_table_entries_into_count
description: Combines three global table entries with division, multiplication and addition, and stores the result in a field of the structure.

name: report_disk_status_bit
description: Tests a bit in a status byte selected by an index and sets the result code to success, failure or error. When the bit is set, it shows a status message that references the disk.

name: toggle_sign_and_negate_short
description: Negates a 16-bit value in one structure and flips the high bit of a byte in another. It returns nonzero when that high bit was previously clear.

name: store_inverted_bit_test
description: Tests a bit of a global byte chosen by an index from a structure field, then stores the inverted result as a 32-bit value in another structure field.

name: return_immediately_stub
description: Returns immediately without touching memory or registers.

name: return_immediately_entry
description: Returns immediately; it is reached only as a call target and performs no work.

name: clear_pending_bit_and_count
description: Clears one bit of a global status byte and, when that bit was set, marks a flag byte in a structure and increments a counter. It calls a sub-routine in that case.

name: return_stub_after_call
description: Returns without doing work; its metadata lists a call to another routine, but the body is only a return.

name: do_nothing_stub
description: Runs five instructions with no observable effect and returns without modifying memory, registers, or calling another routine.

name: return_after_nested_call
description: Returns after a call to another routine; the body has no logic beyond that call.

name: clear_offset_and_save_register
description: Clears a 32-bit word at a fixed offset of a structure and saves a register value into a global.

name: compare_saved_value_then_dispatch
description: Compares an input register with a saved global value. It calls a table entry when they differ and a sub-routine when they match.

name: store_handler_address_global
description: Stores the address of a routine into a fixed memory location, registering it as a handler.

name: copy_string_with_length_prefix
description: When the first byte is above a threshold, copies a null-terminated name into a buffer prefixed with its length, allocates a structure for it, and links that structure into a global table.

name: initialize_device_descriptors
description: Allocates a descriptor structure, sets its flag and pointer fields, then requests a second structure from the library and links both together. The text references the expansion library and the device by name.

name: call_library_method_chain
description: Calls a library function through a table, then calls the function pointer it returns at a fixed offset. It references the dos library by name.

name: send_dos_message_and_wait
description: Builds a message on the stack that names the dos library, sends it through a message port, and waits for the reply before dispatching a table entry.

name: dispatch_reply_table_entry
description: Calls a value-returning routine, stores its result into a structure, and dispatches through the table entry whose key matches a stored value.

name: set_status_and_dispatch_entry
description: Sets a status word to minus one, stores a value into a structure, and calls a table entry chosen by a stored key. It returns after that dispatch.

name: copy_buffered_bytes_with_dispatch
description: Copies bytes from a buffered source into the destination, using a second buffer for wrap-around and clamping the count to the available room. It then dispatches a table entry.

name: write_bytes_into_ring_buffer
description: Writes bytes into a ring buffer in chunks sized to the remaining room, updates the counters, and dispatches a table entry when the write completes.

name: set_count_and_dispatch_entry
description: Calls a routine, stores a stored length as the result count, and dispatches through the table entry that matches a stored key.

name: store_call_result_and_dispatch
description: Calls a routine and stores its low word as the result, or minus one on an error pair, then dispatches a table entry.

name: store_result_or_error_status
description: Calls a routine, stores its result or a failure status in a structure, and dispatches a table entry matched by a stored key.

name: store_result_pair_and_dispatch
description: Calls a routine that returns a result pair and stores the first value into a structure, then dispatches a table entry.

name: fail_on_field_then_dispatch
description: When a counter field is nonzero, calls a library routine, sets the status to minus one, and dispatches a table entry.

name: advance_position_with_limit_check
description: Adds an offset to a stored position and, when the new position would pass the limit, records a fixed error code instead. The result is then dispatched through the table.

name: advance_position_checked_result
description: Adds an offset to a stored position and returns the previous position when it stays within the limit, otherwise records a fixed error code.

name: report_fixed_error_and_dispatch
description: Records a fixed error code and status in a structure, then dispatches a table entry.

name: return_no_op_handler
description: Returns without doing any work; it is reached through a handler pointer.

name: return_no_op_callback
description: Returns without doing any work; it is a callback entry that the caller ignores.

name: return_no_op_shared_exit
description: Returns without doing any work; it is used as a shared exit point.

name: rotate_string_store_length_byte
description: Shifts a null-terminated string one position forward, places its original first byte at the end, and stores the length minus one as a byte just before the string.

name: allocate_block_or_report_error
description: Allocates a structure through the library and fills its fields from the arguments. When allocation fails, it reports a fixed error code through the library and returns zero.

name: release_entry_resources
description: Releases the resources held by an entry when it is set, calling the library with the entry's fields and then freeing the entry.

name: build_path_from_parts
description: Builds a path from a directory string and a file name, allocating a buffer and joining the parts with separators. It returns the new buffer, or zero with an error code when allocation fails or the name is invalid.

name: call_pair_return_flagged_value
description: Calls two routines and returns zero unless a flag is set, in which case it returns the value of the second call.

name: compare_two_strings
description: Compares two null-terminated strings byte by byte and returns as soon as they differ.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The body is only decoded bad data that halts the decompiler, so there is no executable behaviour to describe.

name: return_no_op_shared_target
description: Returns immediately; it is the shared target of several address references.

name: open_course_directory_and_run
description: Opens the dos library, looks up a course directory among the course path entries, and runs the matching course routine through a table. It returns that result, or zero when no entry matches.

name: call_saved_vector_and_return
description: Calls a routine through a saved pointer and returns.

name: install_handler_and_save_previous
description: Saves the current value of a handler slot in a global, then installs a new routine address into that slot.

name: restore_saved_handler_on_match
description: When a flag bit is set and an input code matches a fixed value, it restores the handler slot saved earlier and calls a routine.

name: patch_jump_instructions_at_pointers
description: Writes an address-load instruction and an absolute jump into memory at the given pointers, then loops over the remaining entries. It uses a library call to fetch the memory block.

name: write_device_label_dh
description: Writes the three-character device label dh followed by a colon and a terminator into the buffer.

name: write_device_label_c1
description: Writes the three-character device label c1 followed by a colon and a terminator into the buffer.

name: write_device_label_c2
description: Writes the three-character device label c2 followed by a colon and a terminator into the buffer.

name: return_no_op_stub_b
description: Returns without doing any work.

name: call_structure_vector
description: Calls a routine found through a function table pointer stored inside a structure at a fixed offset.

name: compare_strings_until_mismatch
description: Compares the bytes of two strings over a given length, counting matching bytes and stopping at the first difference or when the limit is reached.

name: run_golf_program_entry
description: Program entry point: it calls the startup routine, creates the screen, and initializes the game. It then loops over course setup and the main game routine, shows the club display, and returns.

name: run_golf_main_loop
description: Repeatedly loads course information and runs the main game routine until course setup reports no more courses, then shows the club display.

name: show_country_club_screen
description: Saves 32 words of colour data, clears the screen, displays the country club graphic referenced by its file name, then restores the saved words.

name: call_quit_library_routine
description: Calls one library routine and returns, with no other logic.

name: clear_screen_area
description: Clears the screen by setting the pen and filling the full display rectangle through two library calls.

name: initialize_golf_game_state
description: Sets initial state bytes and words, copies two tables into the working table, and calls the initialization routines for random numbers, the hole file, and the interface.

name: run_putting_green_round
description: Sets up a putting-green round by copying a background table and clearing four player records. It then repeatedly generates the matrix, draws the green and trees, and runs the aim-and-hit step until the round ends, and shows the club display.

name: run_driving_range_round
description: Sets up a driving-range round by copying a table and clearing four player records. It draws the range and trees, then runs aim-and-hit steps until the round ends and shows the club display.

name: run_course_setup_screens
description: Shows the course and player setup screens and reads keyboard and pointer input to pick a course, level, player count and names. It returns 1 once a round starts and zero when the choice is cancelled.

name: choose_course_from_menu
description: Shows the course selection list, moves the highlight with pointer input, and draws the selected course name. It returns false only for the cancel entry.

name: draw_menu_panel_frame
description: Sets the drawing pen, draws a rectangle for a menu panel, and writes a text label at a fixed position.

name: draw_menu_panel_label
description: Repeats the panel drawing steps of its neighbour, drawing a rectangle and writing a text label at fixed coordinates.

name: clear_menu_board
description: Clears the selection board area and draws the cancel label at a fixed position.

name: read_key_change_flag
description: Compares the latest key code with the stored one, returns zero when they match, and otherwise stores and returns the new code.

name: swap_bitmap_pointers
description: Exchanges the stored bitmap pointer with the spare pointer in the bitmap structure.

name: animate_fade_to_front_band
description: Swaps the bitmap pointers, then copies a band of rows in steps and pauses between each step to fade the image in.

name: check_heap_space_available
description: Rounds an odd size up by one, then reports a shortage through a library call when the request exceeds the remaining space. Otherwise it adds the size to the used total.

name: return_free_heap_bytes
description: Returns the difference between the heap total and the used count.

name: release_chip_heap_space
description: Rounds an odd size up by one and subtracts it from the used heap count.

name: merge_bitplane_rows_with_mask
description: Combines bitplane rows from two source buffers into a destination using an inverted mask and bitwise operations, stepping through rows until the counter runs out.

name: blit_tree_sprite_rows
description: Blends rows of a tree sprite from two source buffers into the destination with an inverted mask and a bitwise or, stepping one row at a time until the count runs out.

name: combine_tree_collision_bytes
description: Reads five bytes at offsets derived from a stride, combines them with a bitwise or, and masks the result with a stored byte. It returns the combined collision byte.

name: run_golf_round_loop
description: Runs the main golf round: it resets player state, then repeatedly generates the matrix, draws the green and trees, handles the aim and hit, and updates distances until the round ends. It shows scores and a leaderboard through a menu of print, best-score and quit options.

name: adjust_aim_and_hit_shot
description: Processes pointer and button input to adjust the aim, redraws the aim and pointer, and launches the shot when the button is pressed. It returns when the input ends.

name: initialize_mouse_pointer_sprite
description: Sets the pointer position from stored coordinates or the aim cursor, draws the pointer sprite, and draws a crosshair of line segments.

name: erase_mouse_pointer_sprite
description: Restores the area under the pointer by copying a seven by seven block from the background.

name: draw_mouse_pointer_sprite
description: Reads the mouse position, moves the pointer toward it in steps capped to a range, draws the pointer lines and sprite, and stores the new position.

name: draw_aim_indicator
description: Draws the aim indicator bars and tick marks at the aim position using rectangle and line calls.

name: erase_aim_indicator
description: Erases the aim indicator rectangle by copying its background back.

name: compute_distance_to_hole_stored
description: Computes the Euclidean distance between the stored position and the selected target using a square root, and stores it in the distance field.

name: compute_distance_to_target
description: Computes the squared offsets to a target point and passes their sum to a square-root routine, discarding the result.

name: draw_tree_and_pin_objects
description: Clears the tree slots and places trees: for each course position it converts coordinates, sorts the entries into a draw list, and displays the trees, pin and stakes that are in range.

name: convert_random_coordinates_to_screen
description: Takes two random values, adds them to stored base offsets, and stores the results as the object's screen coordinates.

name: insert_tree_into_sorted_list
description: Inserts the current tree record into a sorted list by its depth value, linking the neighbouring entries.

name: draw_tree_markers_2d
description: Draws a small marker for each tree at a random position on the top view, using pixel writes in three colours.

name: draw_pin_flag_on_green
description: Draws the pin flag at the hole position as a short pole with a pennant, using move and draw calls, then plots a dot at the top of the pin.

name: draw_distance_stake_marker
description: Draws a stake marker with two vertical lines and a filled bar whose height follows the stored value.

name: seed_random_table_index
description: Stores the low byte of the seed word as the random table index and replaces the seed with the next table entry.

name: next_random_byte_pair
description: Returns two successive bytes from a random table and advances the table index.

name: draw_top_view_course_map
description: Draws the top-down course map with a framed view, the green overlay, tree markers and distance labels, then waits for input until the view is dismissed.

name: decode_run_length_bitmap
description: Decodes a packed bitmap stream: each control byte selects a literal run, a repeated-byte run, or a skip, and writes the output with a fixed row stride after clearing the destination.

name: load_packed_bitmap_from_file
description: Opens a file, reads a header and a list of compressed block sizes, decodes each block into the destination, and closes the file.

name: draw_green_layout_objects
description: Clears the green buffer, converts the object list to screen positions, and draws islands, mud patches and tees in order. It then copies the result to the display, adding the hole and tee marker when their conditions hold.

name: draw_green_top_view_islands
description: Draws the island shapes of the green in the top view, drawing the non-mud shapes first and the mud shapes after.

name: draw_island_outline_polygon
description: Draws an island in the top view by building a polygon from generated vertices and filling it.

name: clip_and_store_object_points
description: Converts each point of the current object to screen coordinates, clips it against the left, right and bottom edges, and appends the surviving points to the output list.

name: add_tee_pad_points
description: Converts twelve generated points to screen coordinates and appends them to the output list as a pad.

name: store_hole_file_pointer
description: Copies a pointer from a hole-file table entry into the hole-file slot.

name: load_hole_data_if_changed
description: When the requested hole differs from the loaded one, loads the hole file from disk and parses its point, object and polygon records. It sorts the point list by coordinate and then sets up trees.

name: parse_hole_records_for_load
description: Parses the point and object records of a hole file into tables, sorts the points, and builds the object list.

name: sort_hole_point_table
description: Reads point records from the hole data into a table and sorts them by one coordinate.

name: sort_points_then_read_objects
description: Sorts the point table with a swap pass, then reads object records from the hole data and fills each object's point list and position fields.

name: read_object_point_lists
description: Reads the point list for each object from the hole data and stores the object's type and position fields, stopping at the end marker.

name: finish_hole_record_setup
description: Stores the final position and flag fields from the hole data, then calls the tree setup routine.

name: read_hole_file_from_disk
description: Opens the hole file, checks its identifier value, reads the header and offset table, and reads the selected hole record into the buffer. It returns a success value, or zero when the open or identifier check fails.

name: check_hole_file_identifier
description: Reads a header from an open file, checks its identifier value, and loads the hole record when the identifier matches.

name: read_then_close_hole_file
description: Reads from an open file, seeks, and closes it through library calls.

name: close_hole_file_then_load
description: Seeks and closes the open file, then reloads the hole file from disk.

name: clip_polygon_bottom_edge
description: Clips a polygon against the bottom screen edge, keeping vertices inside the edge and inserting intersection points where edges cross it. It writes the clipped list to the output.

name: clip_polygon_left_edge
description: Clips a polygon against the left screen edge, keeping vertices inside the edge and inserting intersection points where edges cross it. It writes the clipped list to the output.

name: clip_polygon_right_edge
description: Clips a polygon against the right screen edge, keeping vertices inside the edge and inserting intersection points where edges cross it. It writes the clipped list to the output.

name: install_cia_interrupt_handler
description: Sets up an interrupt structure that points at a handler routine, adds it through the CIA resource, and sets a flag bit in the status word.

name: store_clock_byte_and_reset
description: Stores the input byte in a global variable and then clears a second global variable.

name: remove_cia_interrupt
description: Saves a stored status byte into a global and removes the interrupt through a library call.

name: poll_button_state_flags
description: Calls a library routine to read button state and, when it reports a change, updates four button-state flag words. It returns the bit it read.

name: latch_button_flags_first_pair
description: Sets a status bit and latches the first pair of button flags, clearing the pair when its counter has run out.

name: latch_button_flags_second_pair
description: Sets a status bit and latches the second pair of button flags, clearing the pair when its counter has run out.

name: latch_button_flags_third_pair
description: Sets a status bit and latches the third pair of button flags, clearing the pair when its counter has run out.

name: set_button_flag_fourth_pair
description: Sets a status bit and marks the fourth button-state flag word.

name: initialize_ball_velocity_and_position
description: Computes the ball's velocity from the aim value and power, stores its start position, and resets its counters.

name: store_ball_end_position
description: Stores coordinates read through library calls into the ball structure, adjusting one value by an offset and an extra value when a flag is set.

name: store_ball_position_fallback
description: Stores coordinates read through library calls into the ball structure with an offset, and an extra value when a flag is set; it is the same routine as its neighbour.
